answer: The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, slashed on a failed audit, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. The sparrow of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. A timber of per-task receipts records who did what, and the oasis of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it.
